h1: Baron Residence Bangkok — Serviced Apartment Near Vejthani Hospital, Private Balconies and Free Parking
intro: For families caring for a patient at Vejthani Hospital on Soi Lat Phrao 111 in Bang Kapi, Baron Residence Bangkok on Soi Lat Phrao 130 is one of the most practical options in the area — sitting about 1 km away, reachable by Grab or car in roughly 4 minutes. What makes it worth considering is not just proximity but the combination of private balconies on every room, an on-site restaurant, free parking, and free Wi-Fi, all from around ฿800–1,200 per night. This is not a city-centre showpiece hotel, but for anyone spending several nights in east Bangkok for medical or practical reasons, it earns its score of 8.7/10 across 839 reviews on Trip.com. This review is distilled from real guest voices across Trip.com, Booking.com, and Agoda.

body.html: Overview and who it suits — Baron Residence Bangkok is a 4-star serviced apartment sitting deep on Soi Lat Phrao 130 (Ramkhamhaeng 81) in Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi district, on Bangkok's east side. It was not built for tourists hunting the Grand Palace or Chatuchak Market; it positions itself as a mid-stay base for people with real business in the Lat Phrao–Bang Kapi corridor — patient families at Vejthani Hospital, students and staff at Ramkhamhaeng University, groups attending matches at Rajamangala National Stadium, or simply people who need an affordable, practical room on the east side of the city. The 8.7 score across 839 reviews on Trip.com paints a consistent picture: guests who arrive with the right expectations tend to leave satisfied. Guests hoping for a city-centre luxury hotel will be disappointed.

Location and getting around — The hotel's address is 777 Soi Lat Phrao 130, Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240. The most asked question: how far is it from Vejthani Hospital? Vejthani sits at 1 Soi Lat Phrao 111 — about 1 km from the hotel, a 4-minute drive or Grab ride in normal traffic (allow more at rush hour). Walking is possible but expect sun and some traffic on Lat Phrao Road, adding around 12–15 minutes. For rail, Bang Kapi MRT station on the Yellow Line is roughly 850 m–1 km north along Lat Phrao Road — a 10–12-minute walk or a short Grab. The Yellow Line connects to the Blue Line at Lat Phrao station, giving onward access to Silom, Rama 9, and the rest of the network. The Mall Bang Kapi is about 1.8 km away, a 5-minute ride.

"Stayed 10 nights looking after my mother at Vejthani. Great value — room had a balcony which was a lifesaver, staff were friendly and spoke English, free parking every day. Grab to the hospital took under 5 minutes. Will definitely come back if needed."

Rooms and facilities — Baron Residence Bangkok has 125 rooms (some sources note 87 air-conditioned units, which may reflect the most recently renovated wing), opened in 2012 and renovated in 2015. Room types are Studio A (25 m², queen or two singles), Studio B (21 m², queen or two singles), Deluxe (two singles), and Family (31 m², queen plus one single). Every room has a private balcony — along with air-conditioning, a fridge, a safe, free Wi-Fi, a flat-screen TV, an electric kettle, and a wardrobe. That balcony is the detail that separates Baron Residence from many same-price competitors in the area, because for a multi-night medical stay it means fresh air and somewhere to sit without leaving the room. Real guest reviews consistently mention comfortable beds and clean, well-smelling sheets, though a handful note that some furnishings are showing their age.

Breakfast and on-site services — There is an on-site restaurant serving a breakfast buffet from 06:00–10:00. Real guest feedback describes it as decent but limited in variety — fine for a quick meal before a hospital run, but do not expect the spread of an international chain hotel. Beyond breakfast, there is a convenience store in the complex, a handful of local food shops in the soi, a laundry service, and a 24-hour front desk. The detail that comes up most consistently in positive reviews is the free parking. For families who have driven in from the provinces specifically to receive treatment at Vejthani, having a free, secure car park attached to the room makes a genuine practical difference. There is no swimming pool.

Service and what real reviews actually say — Trip.com's service sub-score of 8.8 sits slightly above the overall 8.7, suggesting staff performance is a genuine strength here. Review after review on Trip.com and Agoda notes friendly, helpful staff who speak workable English and handle check-in smoothly. The picture from TripAdvisor (22 reviews, 3.7 out of 5) is more mixed and harder to dismiss: a few reviewers report cockroach sightings, housekeeping that is not automatic and must be requested, and occasional charges for accidental damage that felt heavy-handed. The gap between the TripAdvisor score and the Trip.com score may reflect different traveller profiles or different time periods; this review presents both sides as found, without softening either.

"Clean room, the balcony was perfect for morning coffee. Wi-Fi strong. Staff helpful and friendly. Free parking was essential — we drove from Chiang Rai for the hospital. For this price in Bangkok you rarely get both a balcony and free parking together."

Price and value — Standard room rates run from roughly ฿800 to ฿1,200 per night depending on room type and dates. Studio B (21 m²) typically starts around ฿800; Studio A (25 m²) around ฿1,000; Family Room (31 m²) around ฿1,200. Prices can move up during long weekends or events at Rajamangala Stadium. At that level, for a room that includes a private balcony, free parking, free Wi-Fi, and sits less than 4 minutes from Vejthani Hospital, the value proposition is clear for the right guest. For very long stays of several weeks, it is worth contacting the hotel directly to ask about extended-stay rates, as many serviced apartments in Bangkok offer them informally.

Things worth knowing before you book — Housekeeping at Baron Residence is reportedly not automatic daily service for all rooms; if you want daily cleaning, request it explicitly at check-in. Breakfast options are limited, so if you want variety, there are several local Thai restaurants in the surrounding soi. The hotel sits deep in a residential soi, so traffic to and from the main road at rush hour can add time to any Grab journey. Finally, free cancellation rates are available on most platforms — given that medical appointment plans can change, always prefer the flexible rate.

highlights.title: ~4-min drive to Vejthani Hospital
highlights.text: About 1 km from Vejthani Hospital (Soi Lat Phrao 111) — a 4-minute Grab or car ride in normal traffic. Practical for patient families who need to come and go at short notice without worrying about distance.

highlights.title: Private balcony on every room
highlights.text: All room types include a private balcony — unusually good for this price tier in Bangkok. For multi-night stays the outdoor space matters: somewhere to sit with a coffee, air dry clothing, and not feel cooped up.

highlights.title: Free parking + free Wi-Fi
highlights.text: Secure, on-site parking at no charge for all guests — a real advantage for the many families who drive in from other provinces for hospital treatment at Vejthani or Ramkhamhaeng Hospital. Strong Wi-Fi included in every room.

honestSummary: Baron Residence Bangkok does what it sets out to do for the right guest — patient families at Vejthani Hospital, self-driving visitors who need free parking, and anyone wanting a balcony room at a reasonable price in east Bangkok. It is not the right choice if your main goal is city-centre sightseeing or if you need to be steps from a rail station.
honestChecks: If you need to walk to Vejthani Hospital — Baron Residence is about 1 km away, a 4-minute drive, not walking distance. If the patient will be moving in and out of the hospital very frequently or has mobility issues, consider 111 Residence, run by the hospital itself, which is attached to the building.

If you want a large room with a kitchen for a very long stay — Studio B at 21 m² is compact for several weeks with full luggage. Opt for the Family Room (31 m²) or ask the hotel directly about extended-stay arrangements and whether any rooms have a kitchenette.

If your main reason for visiting Bangkok is tourism, not the hospital — Soi Lat Phrao 130 is far from Siam, Sukhumvit, and the main visitor areas. Every tourist trip requires a Grab. Choose accommodation closer to the main BTS or MRT lines instead.

tips.title: Plan your Vejthani runs carefully
tips.body: The hotel is about 1 km from Vejthani Hospital. Early morning before rush hour, Grab arrives fast and costs very little. If you have a car, Vejthani has on-site parking and the hotel's free lot means you can come back and leave again without worrying about fees.

tips.title: Bang Kapi MRT (Yellow Line) is walkable
tips.body: Bang Kapi station on the MRT Yellow Line is about 850 m–1 km north on Lat Phrao Road — roughly a 10–12-minute walk or a short Grab. It connects to the Blue Line at Lat Phrao station for access to the wider network.

tips.title: Use the balcony — especially on a long stay
tips.body: Every room has a private balcony and real guests mention it repeatedly. Request a higher floor facing away from direct western sun at check-in to get the most from it. For a 5-night stay after a surgical procedure, that outdoor space matters more than you might expect.

tips.title: Plenty of local food in the soi
tips.body: The surrounding streets have good-value Thai eateries and a convenience store within the complex. After a long day at the hospital, you will not need to go far for dinner. The Mall Bang Kapi — a full shopping mall with food courts and a supermarket — is less than 2 km away.

faq.q: How far is Baron Residence Bangkok from Vejthani Hospital?
faq.a: About 1 km — a 4-minute drive or Grab ride in normal traffic (allow more at rush hour). Walking is possible but takes 12–15 minutes along Lat Phrao Road in the sun. If you need to walk directly to the hospital wards, the only property that genuinely allows that is 111 Residence, run by Vejthani itself right next door to the hospital.

faq.q: Is Baron Residence Bangkok close to an MRT or BTS station?
faq.a: Not directly adjacent, but Bang Kapi MRT station on the Yellow Line is roughly 850 m–1 km north on Lat Phrao Road — about a 10–12-minute walk or a short Grab ride. The Yellow Line connects to the Blue Line at Lat Phrao station, giving access to Silom, Rama 9, and the broader network.

faq.q: Is Baron Residence Bangkok suitable for a long stay of several weeks?
faq.a: Yes, with some caveats. The Family Room (31 m²) is the most comfortable for extended stays, and every room has a private balcony and free parking. There is no in-room kitchen, though; if cooking facilities are important, ask the hotel directly about room options or consider a serviced apartment with a full kitchenette. Ask about extended-stay rates when booking directly.

faq.q: Does Baron Residence Bangkok have free parking?
faq.a: Yes — free on-site parking for all guests. This is one of the most consistently praised aspects in real guest reviews, particularly for families who have driven in from other provinces for treatment at Vejthani or Ramkhamhaeng Hospital.

faq.q: What is the room rate at Baron Residence Bangkok?
faq.a: Rates typically run from approximately ฿800 to ฿1,200 per night depending on room type and dates. Studio B (21 m²) from around ฿800; Studio A (25 m²) from around ฿1,000; Family Room (31 m²) from around ฿1,200. Prices can rise during long weekends or events at Rajamangala Stadium. Always compare across platforms and book a free-cancellation rate when possible.
